summary: Maximilian Kramer won the BMBF’s €6,000 Quantum Future Award first prize for his master’s thesis on a self-correcting quantum algorithm.
quote: A physics student at the Free University of Berlin, Maximilian Kramer, received the first prize of 6,000 euros in this competition for his master’s thesis in 2024, in which he proposes a self-correcting and hardware-friendly algorithm that can be used by the next generation of quantum computers.
